A brand new Apple TV 4K is on the horizon, expected to be unveiled at the iPhone event in a few weeks. Apple code leaks spotted by MacRumors reveal a new Siri Remote will be coming along with it.

macOS Code Mentions New Apple TV Remote

Apple released a series of public and beta software updates yesterday. Among them, the macOS 26.7 RC contains references to a number of yet-to-be-announced products.

MacRumors found that one of the videos shows AirPods with a camera actually working.

A new Apple TV 4K Siri Remote is also included in the list of unreleased products. Juli Clover reports:

Mark Gurman previously reported that the upcoming hardware refresh will come with "what is likely a revamped Apple TV remote."

The discovery of a new Siri Remote in macOS 26.7 confirms that a new remote will indeed be arriving this fall.

No rumors have yet mentioned any specific changes to the remote. However, one frequently requested feature is the ability to more easily find a lost remote. Apple could potentially incorporate the second-generation ultra wideband chip seen in the AirTag 2 into the Siri Remote.

What would you like to see changed in the new Siri Remote for the next-generation Apple TV 4K? Let us know in the comments.
